roster.name: ISA Abstract Model
roster.description: A conceptual metadata model for life-science investigations defining the core entities and relationships (Investigation, Study, Assay, protocols, processes, materials, ontology source references). It serves as the UML/abstract schema that underpins ISA serializations and tools.

roster.name: ISA-Tab format
roster.description: A tab-delimited, human- and tool-readable serialization of the ISA Abstract Model using specific file types (Investigation i_*.txt, Study s_*.txt, Assay a_*.txt) and defined section/column headers and rules for encoding experimental metadata and ontology annotations.

roster.name: ISA-JSON format
roster.description: A machine-oriented JSON serialization of the ISA Abstract Model for representing investigations, studies, assays, materials, processes and ontology references; intended for programmatic consumption and interchange (used alongside ISA-Tab examples and API tooling).
